name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
tagline: Direct income support for farmer households
description: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year given in three equal four-monthly installments directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of landholding farmer families.

name: Post-Matric Rural Youth Scholarship
tagline: Full higher education fee waiver & maintenance stipend
description: Comprehensive scholarship scheme designed to prevent rural student dropouts after 10th standard by covering college admission fees, tuition, exam fees, and monthly study allowance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
tagline: Financial grant for rural pucca house construction
description: Provides financial aid to homeless rural families or those living in kutcha / dilapidated houses to construct a durable, hygienic pucca house with sanitary toilet and LPG connection.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card of head of household

name: National Old Age Pension Scheme
tagline: Dignity and social security pension for senior citizens
description: Monthly direct benefit pension disbursed by the department of social welfare for elderly rural citizens with insufficient livelihood sources.
documentsRequired: Age Proof (Voter ID / Aadhaar / Birth Certificate)

name: Agricultural Equipment Modernization Subsidy
tagline: 50% subsidy on solar pumps, tillers, and drip irrigation
description: State agriculture department subsidy aimed at reducing input costs and labor intensity for small and marginal farmers by subsidizing modern farm machinery.
documentsRequired: Quotation from Authorized Farm Implement Dealer

name: Rural Girl Child Higher Education Grant
tagline: Special endowment grant for rural girl students in college
description: Empowerment incentive paid directly to unmarried female students from rural panchayats who enroll in recognized undergraduate or technical diploma courses.
